card.name: Just before aspartate or Asia/asleep words
card.fires_on: Punctuation or linking words right after ALT, just before the model expects 'aspartate aminotransferase' (AST). Also fires before similar 'as-' words such as Asiatic, asleep and Asp.

modes.label: ALT then AST
modes.description: A comma, 'and' or 'and/or' after alanine aminotransferase (ALT), where aspartate aminotransferase comes next.

modes.label: Other as- words next
modes.description: A word just before an 'as-' word, such as Afro before Asiatic or falling before asleep.
modes.example: have reported suddenly<< falling>> asleep without prior warning of sleepiness while

card.writes: It boosts word starts like 'As' and 'AS', as in aspartate, AST and asleep.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is likely to begin with 'As', most often aspartate after ALT in liver test lists.
